fixture: Same 1 GiB byte stream in torrent order, 256 KiB pieces, window 32. One native sender process and one TCP peer per torrent.
protocol: One warm-up per shape, six counter-free rounds using each order once, then three rotated counts runs per shape. CPU through durable completion. SHA-256 destination checks and checkpoint reopening for both endpoints.
diagnostics: Successful request-bearing channel writes measured at the frame batch boundary for verified transfers. Empty time measures peer-local pending-set gaps between successive reservations, excluding initial and terminal idle. Aggregate across peers before calculating each fraction. Rates and metrics are medians of separate runs.
